evidence: Adopted architectural planning dimensions and floor-space population scenarios, derived from a reference illustration and explicit coverage and occupancy assumptions.
comparison_status: Authorized smaller-crater census, including possible vacuum-era enclosures. Dome span, pressure, material and shielding proposals remain open.

initial_site_scenario.status: Conditional abundance extrapolation and suitability assumptions, pending a catalogue count.

reading_rule: Diameters describe the built ring and crater rim; the estate includes outer gardens. Population equals pi/4 times diameter_m squared times (1 minus population_lake_to_settlement_diameter squared) times non_lake_ground_building_share times mean_storeys divided by floor_m2_per_resident. The supplied population table retains the adopted rounded planning figures.
